SMS360 · Portfolio work sample

Software requirements specification

Homeroom notebook and school-wide average-score visibility.

Adapted from work on SMS360. Examples use fictional records and representative implementation names.

Scope and users

Homeroom teachers maintain one record across several checkpoints. School administrators configure access and review. School leaders review or sign the final section according to their assignment. The electronic gradebook also needed a school-wide control for incomplete averages.

Notebook permissions

RoleRow scopeAllowed actions
School administratorAll classes in their schoolManage notebook access and assign reviewers
PrincipalAll classes in their schoolReview access
Assigned homeroom teacherAssigned classEdit eligible sections and view leadership comments
Assigned reviewerAssigned notebookEdit the leadership comments section

Functional requirements and acceptance criteria

IDRequirementSystem behaviourAcceptance check
HR-01Class notebook identityOn first authorized access, open or create one notebook for the class and academic year using the school-level template.Open the same class in Term 1 and Term 2. The notebook ID is unchanged.
HR-02Notebook listFilter the school’s notebook list by grade and class. Show the teacher, enrollment, completion and assigned reviewer beside each row.With no classes in the selected scope, show an empty state. A failed refresh must be distinguishable from an empty result.
HR-03Role and section accessAllow school administrators to manage their school’s notebooks. An assigned homeroom teacher edits their class record except the leadership comments. An assigned reviewer edits the leadership section.Reassign the teacher. The old teacher loses edit access and the new teacher gains it without recreating the notebook.
HR-04Page loading and exportLoad the section being reviewed. Produce the notebook using the saved data and selected school-level template.Open a term review and export the record after saving. Both use the same class-year record.
HR-05Change auditRecord saved notebook changes with the relevant record, acting user and time. Keep the audit available to authorized operations staff.Save a notebook edit and reconcile the resulting audit with the selected record and actor.
GV-01School-term toggleOnly an authorized school administrator can change the average-column policy. The first release applies one policy per school, academic year and semester.An administrator saves for Term 2. Term 1 and other schools retain their existing policy.
GV-02Effective policyShow the average when configuration is missing or inactive. An active configuration with the visibility flag off hides it.Exercise missing, inactive, active/show and active/hide configurations in both channels.
GV-03Audience and payloadResolve visibility on the backend for web and mobile. When hidden, suppress the average from the audience’s score response.Confirm the average is absent or null under the agreed response contract, and hidden in both interfaces.
GV-04Grade-policy auditRecord a create or update with before/after snapshots, the acting administrator, timestamp and channel.Compare the current setting to the latest audit event after a web change and a mobile change.

Quality requirements

  • Load notebook sections on demand.
  • Keep edits scoped to the authorized school and class.
  • Distinguish an empty result from a processing failure and preserve saved state on a failed update.
